priorityList: Use Mutilate as your single-target builder
Use Envenom as your single-target spender
Maintain Rupture and Garrote at all times
Use Kingsbane and Deathmark on cooldown
Apply Vanish-empowered Garrote before using Deathmark
Use Thistle Tea alongside Kingsbane to avoid overcapping charges
Think about what button is most efficient at a given time, rather than forcing yourself to cast something every time its possible.
Assassination in Single Target plays around a priority list, but these can be broken down slightly more conceptually than other specs which have hard rules for each button.
